body.text: Patients book, move and cancel visits in the app without a call.

rows.s: As a patient, I want to search open slots by provider
As a patient, I want to filter by location and time
As a patient, I want to pick a visit type and book
As a patient, I want a booking confirmation
As a patient, I want to reschedule from the app
As a patient, I want to cancel and free the slot
As a patient, I want a text reminder with a link

As a patient, I want a day-before prep note
